title: First job, then joining Kid Howard's orchestra; self-taught
summary: His first job was a trio with Harrison Verrett and Homer Eugene, using borrowed drum parts; Kid Howard then took him into his ten-piece band. He never learned to read music.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: Well, he had a tambourine. He used to have one hooked on the side of it. He was driving. He had this side cymbal and a little ball on it. Connected to his ball that hit the bass drum and this little thing would hit that cymbal. Well, that answer for us like they got sock cymbals today. Mm-hmm. That was asking for a sock cymbal thing. During those days. They didn't use sock cymbals. Then when the free sock cymbal come out, they had a little small sock cymbal that's weighed on. They didn't play with the sticks all the years with their feet. So that was very low. I remember one time, my first job, I played with three pieces. Harrison Verrett on piano, Homer Eugene on guitar and me on drums. And Nelson had gave me a bass drum and I bought a snare drum. He said it was his runoff bass drum and he gave it to me. He just was laying around the yard. He gave it to me. Well, I made a cassette with it. And I played that job was down in, I don't know if it was Lafitte or I think it was Lafitte that we played the job. Cause Howard had two jobs that night. And he sent me Homer and Harrison Verrett on his job to play this job. And I was kind of shy. The girl said, oh man, you can play. I said, man, I never played two drums. I only played the bass drum. I said, man, you can make it. So I went along with this guy from that night on I've been playing. Then I got into Kit Howard's band. He'd take me into his band in his orchestra. And he had a 10 piece band, 10 piece orchestra. I went into that band and went to playing. I stood with him for about five or six years playing with him in his orchestra. And I started to begin to play with different fellows after that. Different guys began to hire me. But as far as for music, I don't know. The piece of music is the biggest. It's from the bussy. Just picked it up. Well, I was around these guys all my days. Musicians, uh, he's advertised. He used to be out in the truck. I used to, when I was a kid, run behind the truck or the wagon.
